title: 2-Stage Relief Solenoid Open Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses an open circuit in the 2-stage relief solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • None in particular. (Since no current flows, the solenoid is not energized.) • When the cause of failure is resolved naturally, the machine returns to normal.
machine_effect: • The traveling force becomes weak. (The main relief valve is not switched to high pressure setting.) • The one-touch power maximizing function does not operate.
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the 2-stage relief solenoid can be monitored. (As long as the command from the controller is ON, the indication on the monitor is ON even if the solenoid is not energized because there is an open circuit.) (Code: 02300) Reference information The controller senses an open circuit when the solenoid output is OFF.
